item.title: DSA-6508-1 chromium - security update
item.description: Security issues were discovered in Chromium which could result in the execution of arbitrary code, denial of service, or information disclosure. https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/DSA-6508-1

item.title: DSA-6507-1 unbound - security update
item.description: Multiple security vulnerabilities were discovered in Unbound, a validating, recursive, caching DNS resolver, which could result in denial of service, cache poisoning, DNS cookie bypass or potentially the execution of arbitrary code. https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/DSA-6507-1
